opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit is denied, for the reason that application for the writ of certiorari was not made within the time provided by law. Act of February 13, 1925, § 8 (a), 43 Stat. 936, 940; U. S. Code, Title 28, § 350.
